resolved.note: All 13 entries removed because the tests now pass, not because they were reclassified. One was a source defect (the project 'weeks' tab lost its count label in 7713ef0), one was a test-harness defect (a fetch stub without headers, which made resetTimer force a logout), and 11 were assertions left behind by the sprint->week rename (7713ef0), the project tab reorder (b1e4c5a) and the sprint-tabs feature (9f77237).
resolved.counts: 151 tests at the previous capture and 172 when this branch first re-measured (the suite grew on main in between). This branch adds 15 test-case declarations, some via it.each. Main was merged into this branch twice: after the first merge (84f05ff), 214 tests across 24 files, 0 failing; after the second (f7b15c9 -- nine more PRs, including route-level code splitting and a deferred editor), 345 tests across 33 files, 0 failing. The 13 identities this ticket fixes did not change across either merge. Assertions in the three repaired files went from 131 to 147; no test was skipped and none deleted. A residual `(editor.commands as any)` cast inside the quarantined `DetailsExtension.test.ts` test, left behind by an earlier commit that claimed to have removed it, was found and removed during the second merge -- see CHANGES.md.
